blocks.text: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) mein gene of interest ki bohat si aik jaisi copies banti hain: enzyme DNA polymerase diye gaye DNA tukre ko baar baar copy karta hai, reactions ki zanjeer. Kary Mullis ne 1983 mein PCR banaya aur 1993 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize jeeta.

blocks.explanation: Kyunke har baar ki copies agli baar ke liye templates ban jati hain, is liye copy ka amal dohrata aur barhta jata hai.

items: PCR: DNA polymerase se DNA tukre ki baar baar copy (Mullis, 1983).
